retained_dispositions.claim: General singular boundary classification beyond chosen realizations
retained_dispositions.reason: The original baseline requires Dirichlet/Robin/contact and the exact transported Coulomb radial domain, now completed. No theorem for every singular extension is asserted.

retained_dispositions.claim: Coulomb continuum and Dollard long-range comparison
retained_dispositions.reason: M45,M46 give complete measure/onto and modified-wave/completeness arguments.

retained_dispositions.claim: Resonance existence for arbitrary actual potentials
retained_dispositions.reason: Original phase-shift example is an explicitly conditional Lorentzian model. M40/M51 complete its normalization/identification; no universal pole-existence theorem was stated.

retained_dispositions.claim: Unbounded common-domain evolution and adiabatic control
retained_dispositions.reason: M43,M44 and verified Coulomb H² family supply actual unbounded evolution/gapped adiabatic results; static Stark has no isolated ground branch and is not misclassified.
M47,M48 give normalization/envelopes, stable weighted Volterra errors and two-turn fixed-energy barrier calculation.

Canonical source table explicitly calls RAGE/HVZ optional deeper work; A20 promises finite operators/ensembles. M36 and M17/M25 fulfill those; the stronger theorems remain named, not silently deleted or used.
retained_dispositions.destination: Advanced Many-Body Spectral and Thermodynamic Limits

retained_dispositions.reason: A04 specifies an instrument, not a universal classification. M32 now defines general maps/effects and proves actual finite/countable/continuous constructions/dilations.

M38 proves the declared cutoff finite-level NR light–matter model, finite-time emission and coefficient-rate limit. All-time Markov/exponential dynamics was not deduced. Full-QED cutoff removal is not promoted into an established NR prerequisite.
retained_dispositions.destination: Open-system Weak-Coupling Limits; Relativistic Quantum Fields and QED

retained_dispositions.reason: Bach is an actual source-backed qualitative account. Other candidate experiment entries assert no observed data and have no proof-premise role. Missing uncertainty is not fabricated.
Radiation R1–R3 and the fixed massive matter P5 scope are explicit. Covariant matter/pair creation/spin-statistics need the named field-theory framework, not an NR deduction.
Complete local developments and exact permitted math-plan suppliers are supplied; no independent all-item audit or production certification is claimed.

empirical_reports.uncertainty: No quantitative significance or complete calibration budget supplied; source omissions explicitly retained.

model_findings.exact_issue: The static perturbation λ z is unbounded and the Coulomb+linear-field energy form has no lower bound for nonzero λ. M21/M24 cannot justify treating it as a bounded analytic isolated ground-level perturbation.
model_findings.argument: Translate a normalized compactly supported trial function a distance R down the field. Kinetic mean is constant, linear potential mean tends to −infinity, and Coulomb mean tends to zero. Thus the Rayleigh quotient tends to −infinity.
model_findings.disposition: Preserve static-Stark response/resonance calculation as a separate unbounded/asymptotic contract; do not call its ground branch an established M21 eigenvalue theorem.
